findings.claim: The order-of-deploy instruction that prevents a silent billing/quality regression (do not deploy wan-api's removed _REASONING_EFFORT_OVERRIDE until the shared gateway container is reconciled with reasoning_effort in litellm_config.yaml) is written only in a work-tracking file (backlog.md), not in any delivered runbook or docs shipped with the range.
findings.fix: Move the deploy-order warning (reconcile svc-litellm container before removing app-side override) into a delivered operational doc for this range (e.g. a note in the code comment's referenced runbook, or a docs hunk in this repo), not only into backlog.md which is not consulted at deploy time.

findings.claim: The range makes at least one user-facing behavioural change (a new degraded-result UI string keyed off last_error_kind, added in DokladySoupis.tsx) with no corresponding CHANGELOG.md line anywhere in the diff.
findings.fix: Add a CHANGELOG.md entry describing the new degraded-result text and last_error_kind surfacing, per this repo's own CHANGELOG format standard.
